editorial.blurb: A charming neighborhood gem where skilled ramen and sushi craftsmanship shine, with thoughtful staff and a cozy atmosphere that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a Saturday evening for the romantic décor and fairy lights (arrive early to snag a better seat away from the window ledge), and order the Kameya Ramen with extra spice on the side plus the house or Godzilla rolls for a complete experience.
